build_dictionary: build a MaskedLMDictionary from a list of text filenames with configurable threshold and padding
load_dictionary: load a MaskedLMDictionary from an existing dict.txt file for cross-lingual LM tasks
setup_task: setup a CrossLingualLMTask by loading the dictionary and initializing language-to-id mappings
load_dataset: load a multi-lingual dataset split wrapped in MaskedLMDataset with segment IDs per language
add_args: add cross-lingual LM task arguments like tokens-per-sample and monolingual-langs to an argparse parser
